title: Another trial after a difficult choice

captions.energy: Dismissing a whole option over mistakes

meaning: Your domestic choice stays free when an unsuccessful option can be adjusted without cancelling all experience for another easy beginning each time.
text: You can arrange home through mutual attention: hearing a wish, choosing an option together and discussing changes. The Lovers in the physical position of Muladhara describe this participation. The Tower in energy tests your footing through sharply dismissing a decision when inconvenience appears. The Fool in emotions readily welcomes another possibility and a fresh start. Lightness helps you move beyond disappointment, yet can encourage abandoning everything already chosen before distinguishing a genuine flaw from an ordinary correction that would make the arrangement usable by two.

For example, you move a table and discover an awkward passage. You immediately want another room for shared activities and an entirely different setting. **A new possibility need not make the entire previous attempt mistaken.** Sometimes shifting the table slightly is enough. Interest survives while home gains steadiness through accumulated experience. Joint choice becomes a living trial open to correction, rather than another beginning requiring everything to be arranged from zero.

The difficulty is experiencing refinement as lost freedom. Finishing seems less interesting than trying something new, and each detail justifies abandoning the former option. You begin easily and rarely inhabit the result. Peace becomes available when a shared idea survives a small adjustment and new lightness need not repeatedly leave a dismantled space behind. Another approach can build on what you have learned together.
